title: Get property details — tool input (arguments of tools/call)
description: The `inputSchema` of the `get_property_details` MCP tool: what the model sends. Both servers (the local mock and MuleSoft's) must declare exactly this. Derived from PRD T-02 section 5 ('INPUT PARAMETERS — LLM-to-API SCHEMA'), with the same deliberate differences as T-01's input (property-details/README.md, 'Input contract'): parameters are TYPED where the PRD gives the upstream String; `memberId` is absent (anonymous MVP); `language` is added (T-01 input 0.2.0). Defaults are applied by the server. 0.1.0, provisional (2026-10-10). 0.2.0 (2026-10-26): `childAges`, required when `noOfchildren` > 0.

propertyCode.description: The property's code, e.g. "50926". Resolved by the model from the user's property name, or carried from a T-01 result (`property_code`). PRD §5 `propertyCode`.

checkinDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Carried from the T-01 context when present. Server default when omitted: 30 days from today (PRD §5). Must be before `checkoutDate` (enforced by the server).

checkoutDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, after `checkinDate`. Carried from the T-01 context when present. Server default when omitted: the day after check-in (PRD §5: 31 days from today).

noOfadults.description: Server default 1. Carried from the T-01 context when present. Integer, not the PRD's String.

noOfchildren.description: Server default 0. Carried from the T-01 context when present. When above 0, `childAges` is required.

childAges.description: Each child's age in years, one per child: its length MUST equal `noOfchildren`. REQUIRED whenever `noOfchildren` is above 0 (the server rejects a call without it): if the user mentions children but not their ages, ASK their ages before calling; never guess them. Omit, or `[]`, when there are no children. Carried on to the next tools (T-04) and to T-04 `apartmentList[].childAges`, where upstream requires it and decides who counts as a child. Added 0.2.0 (user, 2026-10-26).

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217; every rate in the response uses it. Carried from the T-01 response currency when present. Server default when omitted: the property's own currency, as T-01 (PRD T-02 §5 still says 'the currency associated with the user's region'; see README, 'Input contract').

language.description: The language the user is writing in, set by the model and never asked of the user: a BCP 47 tag from this list (the languages of discoverasr.com, Chinese split by script so the model can pick from what the user typed; Arabic is not supported yet, user decision 2026-10-10). Omit for any other language, or when unsure. The widget shows its own UI text and website links in it; property data (names, descriptions, amenities) stays in the API's language for now. Servers accept it and pass it through untouched (user decision 2026-10-09; not in the PRD).
